Supplied photographs are grouped in photo grids on their matching project detail pages. Captions identify event photos where no equipment is shown. Confirm publication rights and identities with the owner.

Full supplied project photo folders appear in their corresponding project grids: 49 solar-biogas dryer images, 70 thermal-storage dryer images, 80 solar-assisted heat-pump project-event images, and 38 PASET RSIF kickoff images. Optimized 480px, 960px and 1600px WebP copies are in public/images/projects/; the 1600px versions are used by the full-screen viewer.
